title: 1975 AHSME Problem 19
statement: Which positive numbers \(x\) satisfy the equation \((\log_3x)(\log_x5)=\log_35?\)

answerChoices.label: C
answerChoices.text:
only numbers of the form \(5^n\cdot3^m,\) where \(n\) and \(m\)
are positive integers

solutions.text:
For \(x\gt0,\ x\ne1,\) change of base makes the left side \[ \frac{\log x}{\log3}\cdot\frac{\log5}{\log x}. \] Canceling \(\log x\) leaves \(\frac{\log5}{\log3}=\log_35.\) The expression is undefined at \(x=1.\)

Therefore, the correct answer is D.

After cancellation, remember which positive base is forbidden
